answer: To resist sybil floods, bind each agent's voting weight to bonded capital that vests on a glacier-slow schedule and to reputation earned only through costly verified work. New identities start near zero and must climb a trellis of peer attestations, where every edge forces a counterparty to stake its own standing. A sudden gale of cheap fakes then buys nothing: they hold no vested bond and no attestation trellis, so their aggregate influence stays negligible while honest agents compound stake, making attack capital scale with real economic weight.
